lead: Bdubs has a fun-loving, aggro-irreverent tone.
body: It was a lot of fun infusing that brand essence into every piece we made, from banners to menu inserts.

modules.title: Sauce Racers
modules.body: Beckoning the spine-tingling excitement of a classic ballpark mascot race, we created a captivating rich media experience featuring BWW sauces.

modules.title: March Madness ESPN Homepage Takeover
modules.body: March Madness is big business for Buffalo Wild Wings. Our homepage takeover ran the day after Sweet Sixteen weekend ended, a time when most people’s brackets became seemingly worthless. So we gave them a few useful things to do with their useless bracket.

modules.title: BWW Film School
modules.body: We gave fans of Buffalo Wild Wings a shot at making their own BWW commercials. A lot of comedy ensued. Both intentional and otherwise. Participants were able to upload, vote and share their videos with friends (before Meta owned all of that).
